channel.title: MiDEN Technical Insights
channel.description: Elexnova Technical Insights publishes engineering articles on inductor selection, high frequency transformer design, EMI filtering, power supply design and magnetic component applications.

item.title: Factory Capability and Quality Update for Custom Magnetic Components
item.description: A look at the production base behind MiDEN magnetics: 500,000 pcs/day capacity, ISO9001:2015 quality management, in-house engineering and OEM/ODM sample support.

item.title: Common Mode Choke vs Differential Mode Choke: Selection Guide
item.description: Compare noise paths, magnetic structures and impedance behavior to decide when a common mode choke, a differential mode inductor or a combined filter stage is the right answer.

item.title: Common Mode Choke Working Principle for EMI Filter Solutions
item.description: How a common mode choke uses flux cancellation to block common mode noise while carrying load current, and which impedance, current and balance data should be checked before selection.

item.title: EMI Suppression in Power Electronics: How to Reduce EMI in Power Supply Designs
item.description: Reduce EMI in power electronics by separating noise modes, controlling switching loops and selecting magnetic components by impedance across frequency rather than inductance alone.

item.title: EMI Suppression Techniques in Power Supplies
item.description: Practical EMI suppression for power supplies using chokes, transformer construction, shielding, layout control and grounding, with the measurements engineers should request from a supplier.

item.title: How to Choose a Power Inductor for a DC-DC Converter
item.description: Ripple current, saturation current, thermal rise and DCR explained for buck, boost and buck-boost designs, plus the specification sheet a magnetics factory needs to quote accurately.

item.title: Toroidal vs Drum Core Inductors: Which Structure Fits Your Application?
item.description: Choose between toroidal and drum core structures by magnetic containment, manufacturability, cost, board space and the thermal demand of the application.

item.title: Choosing the Right Magnetic Core Material
item.description: Ferrite, iron powder, alloy powder and tape-wound cores compared by permeability, core loss, saturation behavior, temperature stability and cost for a given switching frequency.

item.title: Common Causes of Transformer Failure
item.description: Overheating, insulation breakdown, saturation, winding defects and mechanical stress are the usual failure routes in the field. Here is how each one is detected and prevented.

item.title: Custom Magnetic Components for Industrial Automation
item.description: Automation equipment needs rugged, low-noise magnetics for drives, PLC power stages and sensing circuits. See how custom designs are matched to those constraints.

item.title: Custom Transformer Manufacturing Process
item.description: From drawing review and bobbin or core selection to winding, impregnation, electrical testing and packing: what actually happens between an RFQ and a delivered custom transformer.

item.title: EMI Filter Design Basics for Industrial Electronics
item.description: Build an EMI filter stage from the noise path outward: separating common mode and differential mode noise, placing chokes and capacitors, controlling grounding and preparing for compliance testing.

item.title: High Frequency Transformer Design Guide
item.description: The design flow for high frequency transformers: turns ratio, core and bobbin selection, winding loss, insulation coordination and thermal review for switching power supplies.

item.title: How Common Mode Chokes Protect Communication Systems
item.description: Communication and data lines pick up common mode noise from cables, grounds and nearby power stages. Chokes, impedance balance and layout practice keep the signal path clean.

item.title: How High Frequency Transformers Improve Power Supply Efficiency
item.description: Higher switching frequency shrinks magnetics but shifts loss into core and winding. Learn how transformer material, structure and winding choices trade size against efficiency.

item.title: How to Reduce EMI in Switching Power Supplies
item.description: Source, path and victim: a structured way to reduce EMI in switching power supplies through layout discipline, snubbers, magnetic component choice, shielding and cable control.

item.title: How to Select a Power Inductor for DC-DC Converters
item.description: A step-by-step selection method for DC-DC power inductors: inductance from ripple current, saturation and thermal margin, DCR loss, shielding and the data a supplier needs for a fast quotation.

item.title: How to Select an Inductor Manufacturer
item.description: Supplier selection criteria for magnetic components: engineering response, sample capability, quality system, production capacity, compliance documents and long-term cost stability.

item.title: Inductor Applications in Renewable Energy Systems
item.description: Inductors in solar, wind, storage and charging equipment: current profiles, environmental demands and the specification details that decide whether magnetics survive 20 years in the field.

item.title: Inductor Testing and Quality Control
item.description: Inductance, DCR, saturation, hi-pot, temperature rise and visual inspection: the test plan that keeps inductor batches consistent from sample to mass production.

item.title: Industrial Applications of High Frequency Transformers
item.description: Where high frequency transformers do the work in industry: switch-mode supplies, welding, medical, telecom and motor drive auxiliaries, with selection notes for each application.

item.title: Magnetic Components for EV Charging Systems
item.description: AC and DC EV charger designs depend on PFC inductors, resonant transformers, common mode chokes and output filter magnetics. Review the selection priorities for each position.

item.title: Power Inductor Series for Solar Inverters
item.description: Solar inverter magnetics must handle high DC current, wide temperature swing and long service life. See how boost, MPPT and output filter inductors are specified.

item.title: RoHS and REACH Compliance for Magnetic Components
item.description: What RoHS, REACH and material declaration requests mean for inductors and transformers, and which documents buyers should collect before approving a magnetic component supplier.

item.title: Toroidal Inductors vs Drum Core Inductors
item.description: A structure-level comparison of toroidal and drum core inductors covering stray magnetic field, winding cost, mounting style, thermal behavior and typical application fit.

item.title: Understanding Saturation Current in Power Inductor Series
item.description: What saturation current, rated current and temperature rise really mean on a datasheet, and how much inductance roll-off a high current converter can tolerate before performance drops.

item.title: What Is the Difference Between a Power Inductor and a Common Mode Choke
item.description: Both are wound magnetic components, but current path, core behavior, saturation limits and selection criteria are different. Here is how to avoid mixing them up in a bill of materials.
